chosenApproach: Use the existing immutable protected principal and auth UUID, keep original personal name/avatar in an inaccessible private audit snapshot, brand existing public profile BUKLOD, add backend BEFORE-write reward guards and Finance QMP functions, filter legacy leaderboards before ranking, expose official dashboard RPC and reuse existing Community, announcement, bulletin and BSOC services.
selectionRationale: Changing the role enum or opening a second admin account would threaten authorization, historical authorship, referrals and settlement identity. Immutable principal-scoped economy exclusion preserves privacy, existing roles and legacy financial history with minimal changes.
alternativeApproaches: Create a fresh BUKLOD account and migrate posts/authorship (rejected; identity/history/permissions risk).
Hide earnings and rename profile only in the client (rejected; old clients and backend can still award points).
Keep protected UID, add server-side exclusion and independent Official Console (chosen).
